name: Bench Press
romNote: Bar to the chest; wrists stacked. A rack is optional only if someone can hand the bar off.

name: Overhead Press
romNote: Bar travels over the mid-foot. Do not press from behind the neck.

name: Barbell Row
romNote: Torso angle stays set. The bar comes to the hip, not the floor, unless this is a Pendlay.

name: Back Squat
romNote: Bar on the upper back. Unrack and rerack in the rack — do not walk it out of an empty room.

name: Deadlift
romNote: The bar stays over mid-foot. The floor is the range, not a bounce.

name: Romanian Deadlift
romNote: Full range is hip travel, not floor contact. Stop where the lower back would round.

name: Leg Press
romNote: Do not let the lumbar round at the bottom. The sled can fold the hips under the load.

name: Decline Bench Press
romNote: The bar is over the face on a decline. Unrack with a spot or safeties.

name: Dumbbell Fly
romNote: Elbows stay soft. Do not turn this into a pullover at the bottom.

name: Skullcrusher
romNote: The bar is over the face. A miss is a face hit.

name: Hack Squat
romNote: The sled fixes the path. A collapsed knee or rounded low back still has nowhere to go.

name: Good Morning
romNote: Bar on the back, hips go back. The low back does not become the hinge.

name: Kettlebell Swing
romNote: This is a hinge, not a squat. The bell floats; the arms do not lift it.
